en: The postcard's front shows a black-and-white photograph of a two-story wooden building with the word 'FRÄLSNINGSARMEN' boldly painted on the upper wall. The building is surrounded by a wooden fence and appears to be in a rural setting, with a handwritten message along the right margin. At the bottom, text in Swedish reads: 'FRÄLSNINGSARMÉNS LOKAL I VIFSTA VARF.' The back of the postcard includes a Swedish 5 öre stamp featuring a profile of a royal figure, and the address is written in blue ink.
